items.title: 5.3 Stress, strain aur Young's modulus (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.3 with Fig. 5.3 and Table 5.1 (PDF 96-97).

blocks.text: Mechanical tests ke nataij aam taur par stress aur strain ke zariye bayan hote hain, jo lagai force aur bigaar ke zariye bayan hote hain.

blocks.title: Stress
blocks.text: Stress woh force hai jo jism ki shakal, volume ya lambai mein koi tabdeeli paida karne ko fi unit raqba lagai jaye: stress (sigma) = force (F) / raqba (A) ... (5.1). Stress ka SI unit newton fi muraba metre (N m^-2) hai, jise pascal (Pa) naam diya gaya hai. Jab stress lambai badle to use tensile stress, volume badle to volume stress, aur shakal badle to shear stress kehte hain.

blocks.title: Strain
blocks.text: Strain solid par stress lagne par us ke bigaar ka paimana hai. Ek dimension mein bigaar ke liye strain lambai mein kasri tabdeeli hai: agar delta L lambai ki tabdeeli aur L asal lambai ho (Fig. 5.3a), strain (epsilon) = lambai ki tabdeeli (delta L) / asal lambai (L) ... (5.2). Lambaiyon ki nisbat hone ki wajah se strain be-dimension hai aur us ka koi unit nahi. Tensile stress se strain tensile strain hai, aur compressive stress se paida strain compressive strain. Jab lagaya stress volume badle to fi unit volume volume ki tabdeeli volumetric strain hai (Fig. 5.3b): volumetric strain = delta V / V ... (5.3). Agar y shear stress ke tahat sakht jism ki do mukhalif satahon ka faasla ho aur ek satah delta x phisal jaye (Fig. 5.3c), shear strain gamma = delta x / y = tan theta ... (5.4); radians mein nape chhote theta ke liye tan theta taqreeban theta hai, to gamma = theta ... (5.5).

blocks.alt: Teen hisse. (a) Tensile: dono siron se khinchi bar lambai L se delta L barh jati hai; strain = delta L / L. (b) Volumetric: har taraf se barabar dabaya cube V se V - delta V reh jata hai; strain = delta V / V. (c) Shear: neeche se jure block ko oopar se F sideways dhakelti hai aur woh zaviye theta se jhuk jata hai; strain = theta.
blocks.caption: Tensile (a), volumetric (b) aur shear (c) strain (Figure 5.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Young's modulus
blocks.text: Fi unit strain lagaya stress Young's modulus kehlata hai: Y = tensile stress / tensile strain = (F/A) / (delta L / L) ... (5.6). Us ka unit stress jaisa hai, N m^-2 ya Pa. Agarche naam 19wein sadi ke British scientist Thomas Young par hai, yeh tasawwur 1727 mein Leonhard Euler ne banaya (For Your Information). Wire ka Young's modulus tay karne ke mukhtalif tareeqe hain; ek Searle ka tareeqa hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 m lambi aur 2 x 10^-6 m^2 raqbe ki steel wire 400 N se khinchi jati hai; Y = 2 x 10^11 N m^-2 ke saath extension nikalein. 3 m lambi, 1 x 10^-6 m^2 ki copper wire 500 N ke tahat: stress aur strain nikalein (numerical 5.1, 5.3; copper ka Y 110 x 10^9).

items: Stress = F/A (Pa): tensile (lambai), volume, shear (shakal). Strain: delta L/L (koi unit nahi; tensile ya compressive), delta V/V, shear gamma = delta x/y = tan theta taqreeban theta.
Young's modulus Y = (F/A)/(delta L/L), Pa mein (steel 200, copper 110, heera 1120, sab x 10^9; liquids ka Y = 0). Euler 1727, naam Thomas Young par.
